answer: An agent economy resists Sybils by enforcing quadratic cryptographic stake burning for identity registration. Minting identity i burns C(i) = k * i^2 tokens, imposing superlinear cost scaling on attackers. Because total cost scales as O(N^3), mass replication becomes economically ruinous.
